notes: All 12 views inspected. Inline-four engine assembly with a rocker cover, four intake runners, four exhaust headers merging into a downpipe, a belt drive with crank and accessory pulleys, a distributor, dipstick, oil filter, flywheel with a bolt circle, and a sump with a drain plug. Both sides, the top and the sump underside are fully modelled with no open shells.
limitations: Stylized, not photoreal: this is a Cozy-kit vehicle with a simplified pastel palette.
Static assembly: the crank, pulleys and belt do not animate.
Stylized rather than a dimensionally accurate replica of any real engine.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
